name: Cable Curl (dwie linki)
problem: Parenthesis '(dwie linki)' is not in EX_PAREN, so the English UI shows Polish 'Cable Curl (dwie linki)'.
fix: Rename to "Dual Cable Curl" (or keep the name and add EX_FULL['Cable Curl (dwie linki)'] = 'Cable Curl (two cables)' in lib/i18n.ts)

name: Farmer's Walk (trap bar)
problem: Contradicts the existing Farmer's Walk (corrected 04.10 to [przedramiona, plecy] / [core]) and the draft's own disagreement note: abs=1 makes core a prime mover of a bilateral carry, upper back (traps) carries the load but is only 0.5 and plecy is not counted.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
problem: One kettlebell, one side at a time (note says so), but loadMode total; same-shape entries in this draft (Kettlebell Press, Single Arm Overhead Press (hantel), Kettlebell Clean/Snatch) use unilateral, so volume is halved.

name: Turkish Get Up
problem: Performed per side with one implement; total halves the volume versus the other one-implement per-side entries (Kettlebell Press, Kettlebell Snatch = unilateral).

name: Side Bend (hantel)
problem: Note: 'one dumbbell, one side at a time' -> per-side set, but loadMode total (inconsistent with Single Arm Overhead Press (hantel), External Rotation (hantel) = unilateral).

name: Cable Woodchop
problem: Woodchop is done per side with one handle (cables 1); other single-handle per-side cable moves in the draft (Single Arm Cable Row, Bayesian Curl, Single Arm Triceps Pushdown) are unilateral. Kept total only if it should match Pallof Press (total).

name: Handstand Push Up
problem: triceps=1 while triceps is only a secondary muscle; free-exercise-db: primary shoulders, secondary triceps; Pike Push Up and Overhead Press use triceps 0.5.

name: Svend Press
problem: 'barbell' OR-ed in as a plate proxy: at a place with a barbell but no dumbbells it shows, and loadKindsFor adds the barbell kind, so suggested loads become bar+plates totals (20 kg+), wrong for a plate squeeze.

name: Kettlebell Front Squat
problem: implements 2 / per_dumbbell (two kettlebells), but the name reads as the common single-KB front squat (= Goblet Squat, implements 1); a single-KB user would log half the weight per bell.

name: Front Rack Carry (kettlebell)
problem: implements 2 / per_dumbbell (two kettlebells) is not visible in the name; single-KB front rack carry is also common.
fix: Rename to "Double Kettlebell Front Rack Carry" (or keep and accept)

name: Shrugs (linki)
problem: Inconsistent with Calf Raise (linki) (same 'handle in each hand at the sides' setup = cable.dual & cable.low, cables 2). On the owner's electric station (two low cables) shrugs are done with two handles, so cables 1 halves station volume.

name: Single Arm Cable Chest Press
problem: cable.mid only hides it at the owner's home (electric station, two low cables, no arms option). A one-arm press from a low pulley (slight low-to-high path) is common; Single Arm Cable Fly already accepts cable.low.

name: Donkey Kick
problem: 'ankle_strap' is a cable accessory (electric-station option); recommending it for a bodyweight move shows a misleading 'missing: ankle straps' hint everywhere except at the station. The cable version is Cable Kickback.

name: Frog Pump
problem: db recommended but loadSource bodyweight, so loadKindsFor never offers dumbbell weights; R3 entries (Walking Lunges, Split Squat) use loadSource dumbbell + implements when db is recommended. Glute Bridge (closest existing) has no db.
fix: Either recommended ["floor_mat"] (match Glute Bridge) or loadSource "dumbbell" + implements 1 (R3)

name: Seal Row (sztanga)
problem: A standard flat bench is too low for a seal row (bar/plates hit the floor before full extension); requires barbell & bench.flat will show it at every home with a barbell and flat bench. No 'seal row bench' capability exists.
fix: Keep and lower confidence to 'low', or require [["barbell"],["bench.flat"],["box"]] (bench raised on boxes/plates)

name: Pallof Hold
problem: Near-duplicate by meaning of existing Pallof Press (same setup, isometric). Distinct metric (weight_time) justifies it only if the owner wants both.
fix: Owner decision: keep, or drop and log holds under Pallof Press

name: Sumo Squat (hantel)
problem: Overlaps Sumo Deadlift (kettlebell): a dumbbell hanging between the legs in a wide stance is the same movement (db/kb accepted in both), with different groups (nogi vs pośladki) and muscleLoad; ranking/swap will treat them as different exercises.
fix: Owner decision: keep one (suggest keeping Sumo Squat (hantel) with requires [["db","kb"]]) or note the distinction (goblet-held vs hanging) in the name

name: Single Leg RDL (hantel)
problem: Existing RDL (sztanga) and RDL (hantle/linki) are in group 'plecy'; the single-leg versions are in 'nogi', so a group filter splits the RDL family.
fix: plecy (also for Single Leg RDL (linki)), or move all RDLs to nogi in a separate decision

name: Single Leg RDL (linki)
problem: Same as Single Leg RDL (hantel): RDL family is in 'plecy'.

name: Upright Row (sztanga)
problem: ez_bar alternative is not mapped by loadKindsFor (only 'barbell'/'db'/'kb'/cable./machine caps), so at a place with only an EZ bar the exercise is available but gets no load list. Same for Reverse Curl.
fix: Accept (unknown loads) or map 'ez_bar' -> kind 'ez_bar' in lib/equipment.ts loadKindsFor

name: Wiosłowanie na linkach (siedząc)
problem: This is the owner's home row (EN 'Seated Cable Row (home)'), done on the electric station with two low cables (like Wyciskanie na linkach (stojąc) = 2); cables 1 copies the gym Seated Cable Row and halves station volume (Q-024).

name: RDL (hantle/linki)
problem: Cable option on the owner's station = one handle per hand from two low cables (2); 1 fits only a bar on a single gym pulley. Draft's own cablesNote flags the ambiguity.
fix: Owner decision; 2 if the station is the cable option in use
